correctness.rationale: For each nonfacet, the missing-axis opposite vertices put zero in the complement; included coordinates have nonpositive signed complement entries, and sharp weighted Cauchy–Schwarz yields the claimed distance and witness. For facets, complement = opposite signed facet and triangle/convexity imply exactly twice the weighted minimum norm. Strict rank comparisons, vertex distances and reciprocal-weight inequalities prove all minimizers, counts, exact ratio and equality characterization for any d>=2 and all positive semiaxes. 712 independent QP comparisons in 8 weight systems corroborate; finite computations are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: Pyramidal width is a natural condition measure in Frank–Wolfe rates. The all-rank distance spectrum under arbitrary positive semiaxis scalings, exact bottleneck supports and multiplicities, and strict Euclidean aspect-ratio rigidity characterize a geometrically meaningful infinite family beyond its known regular member. Euclidean facial distance is not affine invariant; this is not merely a coordinate renaming. The formulas are usable directly when selecting axis preconditioning.
